description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of four methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across two metrics: Accuracy (%) on the left y-axis (ranging from 70 to 100 in increments of 5) and Token Count on the right y-axis (ranging from 0 to 800 in increments of 100), with each method represented by a distinct color-coded bar pair. The red bar for CoT shows an accuracy of 91.19% and a token count of 676.85, the orange bar for CoD shows 80.89% accuracy and 534.24 tokens, the light blue bar for CCoT shows 88.40% accuracy and 445.91 tokens, and the green bar for CoUT shows 88.40% accuracy and 354.46 tokens. The chart’s legend at the bottom matches each method to its respective color, and the bars are arranged side-by-side for each method, allowing direct comparison of accuracy and token efficiency. Notably, CoT achieves the highest accuracy but also the highest token count, while CoUT achieves the same accuracy as CCoT with significantly fewer tokens, suggesting a more efficient reasoning process. The chart visually emphasizes the trade-off between performance and computational cost, with CoUT standing out as the most token-efficient method among those achieving high accuracy.
